chart_review.review_order: strictly chronological; every sheet and every chart was inspected before this rule freeze

economic_hypothesis: A broad-market uptrend can pause while capital rotates among stocks. A same-session undercut and recovery is only evidence that supply may have been absorbed. It becomes actionable only when a still-valid leader subsequently closes through the objective pre-existing ten-session pressure platform. The absorption low is the causal invalidation level.

compressed_five_rules.1_market_habitat: At the completed mother-session close the causal market state is BULL: median stock ret20 and ret60 are positive and their positive-return shares exceed 0.50. The current ret20 is below ret60, representing a slowing but still positive broad market. No future market return, future trough, calendar label, or later regime revision is permitted.
compressed_five_rules.2_leader_structure: At the close immediately before the mother session, the stock's close lies in the upper half of its preceding 60 completed-session coordinate high-low range. The already-frozen mother also requires lagged ret60 between +5% and +60%. This excludes nominal relative leaders whose own price structure has already broken.
compressed_five_rules.3_absorption_mother: Reuse the parent mother unchanged: 5%-15% controlled pullback from the prior-ten-session high, fresh five-session low undercut, down-open, at least 2% intraday downside excursion, close at or above the prior close in the top 30% of the range, turnover at least its prior-20 median, and no price-limit artifact.
compressed_five_rules.4_demand_confirmation: During the next three market sessions, before any completed close below the frozen mother-session coordinate low, require the first fully valid completed close strictly above the frozen prior-ten-session coordinate high. The confirmation decision is made only after that close; no same-session fill is allowed.
compressed_five_rules.5_execution_and_exit: Buy at the first legal, non-limit-up open strictly after confirmation and no later than three market sessions after it. Then take +10% gross if reached after entry; if a fully valid completed close falls strictly below the frozen mother low, exit at the first later legal, non-limit-down open; otherwise exit at the H20 legal open. Charge 20 bps per side. Preserve T+1, suspensions, price limits, coordinate lineage, and corporate-action gates.

why_these_rules: Across losing clusters, the mother candle often occurred at a mature top or inside repeated range churn and was followed by no genuine platform acceptance.
Across profitable charts, the recurring structure was a still-intact leader, a bounded shakeout, and a prompt close through the already-known pressure platform followed by price discovery.
The mother candle alone was not enough in the 2016 range market, the April 2019 rollover, or the August-September 2020 distribution cluster.
The mother low is objective and known before entry; using it as invalidation avoids hindsight support drawing.
prohibited: intraday ordering assumptions for a close-confirmed signal
2022-2024 signal or outcome access before the gate
portfolio replay before the signal-level gate
